{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /root/.claude/skills/pdf\n\n# PDF Processing Guide\n\n## Overview\n\nThis guide covers essential PDF processing operations using Python libraries and command-line tools. For advanced features, JavaScript libraries, and detailed examples, see reference.md. If you need to fill out a PDF form, read forms.md and follow its instructions.\n\n## Quick Start\n\n```python\nfrom pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter\n\n# Read a PDF\nreader = PdfReader(\"document.pdf\")\nprint(f\"Pages: {len(reader.pages)}\")\n\n# Extract text\ntext = \"\"\nfor page in reader.pages:\n    text += page.extract_text()\n```\n\n## Python Libraries\n\n### pypdf - Basic Operations\n\n#### Merge PDFs\n```python\nfrom pypdf import PdfWriter, PdfReader\n\nwriter = PdfWriter()\nfor pdf_file in [\"doc1.pdf\", \"doc2.pdf\", \"doc3.pdf\"]:\n    reader = PdfReader(pdf_file)\n    for page in reader.pages:\n        writer.add_page(page)\n\nwith open(\"merged.pdf\", \"wb\") as output:\n    writer.write(output)\n```\n\n#### Split PDF\n```python\nreader = PdfReader(\"input.pdf\")\nfor i, page in enumerate(reader.pages):\n    writer = PdfWriter()\n    writer.add_page(page)\n    with open(f\"page_{i+1}.pdf\", \"wb\") as output:\n        writer.write(output)\n```\n\n#### Extract Metadata\n```python\nreader = PdfReader(\"document.pdf\")\nmeta = reader.metadata\nprint(f\"Title: {meta.title}\")\nprint(f\"Author: {meta.author}\")\nprint(f\"Subject: {meta.subject}\")\nprint(f\"Creator: {meta.creator}\")\n```\n\n#### Rotate Pages\n```python\nreader = PdfReader(\"input.pdf\")\nwriter = PdfWriter()\n\npage = reader.pages[0]\npage.rotate(90)  # Rotate 90 degrees clockwise\nwriter.add_page(page)\n\nwith open(\"rotated.pdf\", \"wb\") as output:\n    writer.write(output)\n```\n\n### pdfplumber - Text and Table Extraction\n\n#### Extract Text with Layout\n```python\nimport pdfplumber\n\nwith pdfplumber.open(\"document.pdf\") as pdf:\n    for page in pdf.pages:\n        text = page.extract_text()\n        print(text)\n```\n\n#### Extract Tables\n```python\nwith pdfplumber.open(\"document.pdf\") as pdf:\n    for i, page in enumerate(pdf.pages):\n        tables = page.extract_tables()\n        for j, table in enumerate(tables):\n            print(f\"Table {j+1} on page {i+1}:\")\n            for row in table:\n                print(row)\n```\n\n#### Advanced Table Extraction\n```python\nimport pandas as pd\n\nwith pdfplumber.open(\"document.pdf\") as pdf:\n    all_tables = []\n    for page in pdf.pages:\n        tables = page.extract_tables()\n        for table in tables:\n            if table:  # Check if table is not empty\n                df = pd.DataFrame(table[1:], columns=table[0])\n                all_tables.append(df)\n\n# Combine all tables\nif all_tables:\n    combined_df = pd.concat(all_tables, ignore_index=True)\n    combined_df.to_excel(\"extracted_tables.xlsx\", index=False)\n```\n\n### reportlab - Create PDFs\n\n#### Basic PDF Creation\n```python\nfrom reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter\nfrom reportlab.pdfgen import canvas\n\nc = canvas.Canvas(\"hello.pdf\", pagesize=letter)\nwidth, height = letter\n\n# Add text\nc.drawString(100, height - 100, \"Hello World!\")\nc.drawString(100, height - 120, \"This is a PDF created with reportlab\")\n\n# Add a line\nc.line(100, height - 140, 400, height - 140)\n\n# Save\nc.save()\n```\n\n#### Create PDF with Multiple Pages\n```python\nfrom reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter\nfrom reportlab.platypus import SimpleDocTemplate, Paragraph, Spacer, PageBreak\nfrom reportlab.lib.styles import getSampleStyleSheet\n\ndoc = SimpleDocTemplate(\"report.pdf\", pagesize=letter)\nstyles = getSampleStyleSheet()\nstory = []\n\n# Add content\ntitle = Paragraph(\"Report Title\", styles['Title'])\nstory.append(title)\nstory.append(Spacer(1, 12))\n\nbody = Paragraph(\"This is the body of the report. \" * 20, styles['Normal'])\nstory.append(body)\nstory.append(PageBreak())\n\n# Page 2\nstory.append(Paragraph(\"Page 2\", styles['Heading1']))\nstory.append(Paragraph(\"Content for page 2\", styles['Normal']))\n\n# Build PDF\ndoc.build(story)\n```\n\n## Command-Line Tools\n\n### pdftotext (poppler-utils)\n```bash\n# Extract text\npdftotext input.pdf output.txt\n\n# Extract text preserving layout\npdftotext -layout input.pdf output.txt\n\n# Extract specific pages\npdftotext -f 1 -l 5 input.pdf output.txt  # Pages 1-5\n```\n\n### qpdf\n```bash\n# Merge PDFs\nqpdf --empty --pages file1.pdf file2.pdf -- merged.pdf\n\n# Split pages\nqpdf input.pdf --pages . 1-5 -- pages1-5.pdf\nqpdf input.pdf --pages . 6-10 -- pages6-10.pdf\n\n# Rotate pages\nqpdf input.pdf output.pdf --rotate=+90:1  # Rotate page 1 by 90 degrees\n\n# Remove password\nqpdf --password=mypassword --decrypt encrypted.pdf decrypted.pdf\n```\n\n### pdftk (if available)\n```bash\n# Merge\npdftk file1.pdf file2.pdf cat output merged.pdf\n\n# Split\npdftk input.pdf burst\n\n# Rotate\npdftk input.pdf rotate 1east output rotated.pdf\n```\n\n## Common Tasks\n\n### Extract Text from Scanned PDFs\n```python\n# Requires: pip install pytesseract pdf2image\nimport pytesseract\nfrom pdf2image import convert_from_path\n\n# Convert PDF to images\nimages = convert_from_path('scanned.pdf')\n\n# OCR each page\ntext = \"\"\nfor i, image in enumerate(images):\n    text += f\"Page {i+1}:\\n\"\n    text += pytesseract.image_to_string(image)\n    text += \"\\n\\n\"\n\nprint(text)\n```\n\n### Add Watermark\n```python\nfrom pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter\n\n# Create watermark (or load existing)\nwatermark = PdfReader(\"watermark.pdf\").pages[0]\n\n# Apply to all pages\nreader = PdfReader(\"document.pdf\")\nwriter = PdfWriter()\n\nfor page in reader.pages:\n    page.merge_page(watermark)\n    writer.add_page(page)\n\nwith open(\"watermarked.pdf\", \"wb\") as output:\n    writer.write(output)\n```\n\n### Extract Images\n```bash\n# Using pdfimages (poppler-utils)\npdfimages -j input.pdf output_prefix\n\n# This extracts all images as output_prefix-000.jpg, output_prefix-001.jpg, etc.\n```\n\n### Password Protection\n```python\nfrom pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter\n\nreader = PdfReader(\"input.pdf\")\nwriter = PdfWriter()\n\nfor page in reader.pages:\n    writer.add_page(page)\n\n# Add password\nwriter.encrypt(\"userpassword\", \"ownerpassword\")\n\nwith open(\"encrypted.pdf\", \"wb\") as output:\n    writer.write(output)\n```\n\n## Quick Reference\n\n| Task | Best Tool | Command/Code |\n|------|-----------|--------------|\n| Merge PDFs | pypdf | `writer.add_page(page)` |\n| Split PDFs | pypdf | One page per file |\n| Extract text | pdfplumber | `page.extract_text()` |\n| Extract tables | pdfplumber | `page.extract_tables()` |\n| Create PDFs | reportlab | Canvas or Platypus |\n| Command line merge | qpdf | `qpdf --empty --pages ...` |\n| OCR scanned PDFs | pytesseract | Convert to image first |\n| Fill PDF forms | pdf-lib or pypdf (see forms.md) | See forms.md |\n\n## Next Steps\n\n- For advanced pypdfium2 usage, see reference.md\n- For JavaScript libraries (pdf-lib), see reference.md\n- If you need to fill out a PDF form, follow the instructions in forms.md\n- For troubleshooting guides, see reference.md\n\n\nARGUMENTS: /root/calendar.pdf"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"e94da18f-8678-4b98-bb67-f176dc6b73cb","uuid":"e6fe7e1f-cf5a-4f85-bccb-833fb14f4bca","timestamp":"2026-03-23T22:44:32.008Z","isSynthetic":true}

PyMuPDF\nfrom PIL import Image\nimport io\nimport json\n\nPDF_PATH = \"/root/calendar.pdf\"\n\n# ─── 1. pdfplumber analysis ────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"PDFPLUMBER ANALYSIS\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\nwith pdfplumber.open(PDF_PATH) as pdf:\n    print(f\"\\nNumber of pages: {len(pdf.pages)}\")\n\n    for page_num, page in enumerate(pdf.pages):\n        print(f\"\\n{'─'*60}\")\n        print(f\"PAGE {page_num + 1}\")\n        print(f\"{'─'*60}\")\n        print(f\"  Width : {page.width}\")\n        print(f\"  Height: {page.height}\")\n        print(f\"  BBox  : {page.bbox}\")\n\n        # ── Words with bounding boxes ──────────────────────────────────────\n        words = page.extract_words(x_tolerance=3, y_tolerance=3)\n        print(f\"\\n  TEXT ELEMENTS ({len(words)} words):\")\n        print(f\"  {'Text':<30} {'x0':>7} {'y0':>7} {'x1':>7} {'y1':>7}\")\n        print(f\"  {'-'*58}\")\n        for w in words:\n            print(f\"  {w['text']:<30} {w['x0']:>7.2f} {w['top']:>7.2f} {w['x1']:>7.2f} {w['bottom']:>7.2f}\")\n\n        # ── Raw chars ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n        # (useful for font-colour info)\n        chars = page.chars\n        print(f\"\\n  CHARS sample (first 20 with colour info):\")\n        print(f\"  {'Char':<5} {'x0':>7} {'y0':>7} {'fontname':<30} {'size':>6} {'color'}\")\n        print(f\"  {'-'*70}\")\n        for c in chars[:20]:\n            color = c.get('non_stroking_color') or c.get('stroking_color')\n            print(f\"  {c['text']:<5} {c['x0']:>7.2f} {c['top']:>7.2f} {c.get('fontname',''):<30} {c.get('size',0):>6.2f} {color}\")\n\n        # ── Rectangles / shapes ───────────────────────────────────────────\n        rects = page.rects\n        print(f\"\\n  RECTANGLES ({len(rects)} total):\")\n        print(f\"  {'x0':>7} {'y0':>7} {'x1':>7} {'y1':>7} {'width':>7} {'height':>7}  fill                   stroke\")\n        print(f\"  {'-'*80}\")\n        for r in rects:\n            fill   = r.get('non_stroking_color')\n            stroke = r.get('stroking_color')\n            w_val  = r['x1'] - r['x0']\n            h_val  = r['y1'] - r['y0']\n            print(f\"  {r['x0']:>7.2f} {r['top']:>7.2f} {r['x1']:>7.2f} {r['bottom']:>7.2f} \"\n                  f\"{w_val:>7.2f} {h_val:>7.2f}  {str(fill):<22}  {stroke}\")\n\n        # ── Lines ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n        lines = page.lines\n        print(f\"\\n  LINES ({len(lines)} total):\")\n        print(f\"  {'x0':>7} {'y0':>7} {'x1':>7} {'y1':>7}  stroke\")\n        print(f\"  {'-'*55}\")\n        for ln in lines[:60]:\n            stroke = ln.get('stroking_color')\n            print(f\"  {ln['x0']:>7.2f} {ln['top']:>7.2f} {ln['x1']:>7.2f} {ln['bottom']:>7.2f}  {stroke}\")\n        if len(lines) > 60:\n            print(f\"  ... ({len(lines)-60} more lines not shown)\")\n\n        # ── Curves ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n        curves = page.curves\n        print(f\"\\n  CURVES ({len(curves)} total) — first 10:\")\n        for cv in curves[:10]:\n            print(f\"    {cv}\")\n\n        # ── Full plain text ────────────────────────────────────────────────\n        print(f\"\\n  FULL EXTRACTED TEXT:\")\n        print(page.extract_text())\n\n\n# ─── 2. PyMuPDF deep dive ─────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"PYMUPDF ANALYSIS\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\ndoc = fitz.open(PDF_PATH)\nprint(f\"\\nNumber of pages: {doc.page_count}\")\n\nfor page_num in range(doc.page_count):\n    page = doc[page_num]\n    print(f\"\\n{'─'*60}\")\n    print(f\"PAGE {page_num + 1}  —  size: {page.rect}\")\n\n    # ── Drawings (paths, filled shapes) ───────────────────────────────────\n    drawings = page.get_drawings()\n    print(f\"\\n  DRAWINGS/PATHS ({len(drawings)} total):\")\n    # Separate by fill color\n    colored = [d for d in drawings if d.get('fill') is not None]\n    print(f\"  Filled shapes: {len(colored)}\")\n\n    # Group by fill color\n    color_groups: dict = {}\n    for d in colored:\n        fill = d['fill']\n        # Normalise to a 3-tuple (drop alpha if present)\n        if isinstance(fill, (list, tuple)) and len(fill) >= 3:\n            key = tuple(round(v, 3) for v in fill[:3])\n        else:\n            key = fill\n        color_groups.setdefault(key, []).append(d)\n\n    print(f\"\\n  Distinct fill colors found: {len(color_groups)}\")\n    for color, shapes in sorted(color_groups.items(), key=lambda x: str(x[0])):\n        # Convert 0-1 floats to 0-255 ints for readability\n        if isinstance(color, tuple) and len(color) == 3:\n            rgb255 = tuple(int(round(v * 255)) for v in color)\n            hex_color = \"#{:02X}{:02X}{:02X}\".format(*rgb255)\n        else:\n            rgb255 = color\n            hex_color = str(color)\n        print(f\"\\n  Color {color} → RGB{rgb255} {hex_color}  ({len(shapes)} shapes):\")\n        for d in shapes:\n            rect = d['rect']\n            print(f\"    rect=({rect.x0:.1f}, {rect.y0:.1f}, {rect.x1:.1f}, {rect.y1:.1f})  \"\n                  f\"w={rect.width:.1f}  h={rect.height:.1f}\")\n\n    # ── Text blocks ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    blocks = page.get_text(\"dict\")[\"blocks\"]\n    text_blocks = [b for b in blocks if b[\"type\"] == 0]\n    print(f\"\\n  TEXT BLOCKS ({len(text_blocks)}):\")\n    for b in text_blocks:\n        for line in b[\"lines\"]:\n            for span in line[\"spans\"]:\n                color_int = span.get(\"color\", 0)\n                # fitz encodes text colour as a packed int\n                r = (color_int >> 16) & 0xFF\n                g = (color_int >> 8)  & 0xFF\n                bv = color_int & 0xFF\n                hex_col = \"#{:02X}{:02X}{:02X}\".format(r, g, bv)\n                print(f\"    '{span['text']}'  bbox={tuple(round(v,1) for v in span['bbox'])}  \"\n                      f\"size={span['size']:.1f}  color={hex_col}\")\n\n    # ── Annotations ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    annots = list(page.annots())\n    if annots:\n        print(f\"\\n  ANNOTATIONS ({len(annots)}):\")\n        for a in annots:\n            print(f\"    {a}\")\n\ndoc.close()\n\n\n# ─── 3. Convert first page to image and save ──────────────────────────────\n\nprint(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"IMAGE CONVERSION\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\n\ndoc = fitz.open(PDF_PATH)\npage = doc[0]\n\n# Render at 150 DPI (scale=150/72 ≈ 2.08)\nmat = fitz.Matrix(2.0, 2.0)\npix = page.get_pixmap(matrix=mat)\nimg_path = \"/root/calendar_page1.png\"\npix.save(img_path)\nprint(f\"\\nPage 1 saved as PNG: {img_path}\")\nprint(f\"  Rendered size: {pix.width} x {pix.height} px\")\n\ndoc.close()\n\nprint(\"\\nDone.\")\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":231,"cache_read_input_tokens":8532,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":231,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":38,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":"toolu_01Wbx76gWthTvZanD34GFkGs","session_id":"e94da18f-8678-4b98-bb67-f176dc6b73cb","uuid":"1a2a76dc-e8db-41ae-b9f0-59f54a97fae4"}

In 2026, DST falls on Sunday, March 8, which is the earliest possible date it can land on in March.\n\n---\n\n### 🌍 UTC Offset for Eastern Time\n\nAfter Daylight Saving Time begins and through the summer months, the period is called **\"Daylight Time\"**, abbreviated **\"DT.\"** When Daylight Saving Time ends, we return to **\"Standard Time\"** or **\"ST.\"** For example, **Eastern Daylight Time is EDT**, and **Eastern Standard Time is EST.**\n\n- **Before March 8** (Winter): Eastern Standard Time (EST) = **UTC−5**\n- **After March 8** (Summer): Eastern Daylight Time (EDT) = **UTC−4**\n\n---\n\n### 📅 DST End Date (Fall Back):\nWhen local daylight time reaches **Sunday, November 1, 2026, 2:00:00 AM**, clocks are turned **backward 1 hour** to 1:00:00 AM local standard time.\n\n---\n\n### 🌎 International Note:\nBetween **March 8 and March 29, 2026**, the US has already sprung forward but Europe hasn't. That means the **New York-to-London time difference temporarily drops from five hours to four.**\n\n---\n\n### ⚖️ Legal Basis:\nDaylight Saving Time in the USA starts on the second Sunday in March and ends on the first Sunday in November. << 'EOF'\n# Complete calculation using the script output\n\n# Time label y positions (from pdfplumber)\ntime_labels = {\n    '12am': 39.25,  # need to derive this — not present directly; use the grid\n    '1am':  69.13,\n    '2am':  99.09,\n    '3am':  129.06,\n    '4am':  159.02,\n    '5am':  188.98,\n    '6am':  218.95,\n    '7am':  248.91,\n    '8am':  278.87,\n    '9am':  308.83,\n    '10am': 338.80,\n    '11am': 368.76,\n    '12pm': 398.72,\n    '1pm':  428.69,\n    '2pm':  458.65,\n    '3pm':  488.61,\n    '4pm':  518.57,\n    '5pm':  548.54,\n    '6pm':  578.50,  # derived (548.54 + 29.96)\n    '7pm':  608.46,\n    '8pm':  638.42,\n    '9pm':  668.39,\n    '10pm': 698.35,\n    '11pm': 728.31,\n}\n\n# The spacing between consecutive hours\n# 1am - 2am: 99.09 - 69.13 = 29.96\n# Let's compute average spacing precisely\nhours_in_order = ['1am','2am','3am','4am','5am','6am','7am','8am','9am','10am','11am','12pm','1pm','2pm','3pm','4pm','5pm']\nspacings = []\nfor i in range(len(hours_in_order)-1):\n    s = time_labels[hours_in_order[i+1]] - time_labels[hours_in_order[i]]\n    spacings.append(s)\n    \navg_spacing = sum(spacings) / len(spacings)\nprint(f\"Average spacing between hours: {avg_spacing:.4f} pt\")\nprint(f\"15-min increment: {avg_spacing/4:.4f} pt\")\n\n# Derive 12am y position\ny_12am = time_labels['1am'] - avg_spacing\nprint(f\"Derived 12am y position: {y_12am:.4f}\")\n\n# The horizontal lines: first is at 36.49\n# The header offset: difference between first h-line and 12am label\nfirst_hline = 36.49\nprint(f\"First h-line y: {first_hline}\")\nprint(f\"12am label y: {y_12am:.4f}\")\nprint(f\"Header offset (first h-line to 12am label): {y_12am - first_hline:.4f}\")\n\n# Colored rectangles\ncolored_rects = [\n    {'y0': 44.89, 'y1': 297.57, 'h': 252.68, 'fill': (0.3804, 0.3804, 0.3804), 'color': 'dark gray'},\n    {'y0': 314.56, 'y1': 342.52, 'h': 27.96,  'fill': (0.9020, 0.4863, 0.4510), 'color': 'salmon/red'},\n    {'y0': 374.48, 'y1': 387.46, 'h': 12.98,  'fill': (0.7529, 0.7922, 0.2000), 'color': 'yellow-green'},\n    {'y0': 434.41, 'y1': 477.35, 'h': 42.94,  'fill': (0.9020, 0.4863, 0.4510), 'color': 'salmon/red'},\n    {'y0': 509.32, 'y1': 552.26, 'h': 42.94,  'fill': (0.4745, 0.5255, 0.7961), 'color': 'blue #7986CB'},\n    {'y0': 584.22, 'y1': 762.00, 'h': 177.78, 'fill': (0.3804, 0.3804, 0.3804), 'color': 'dark gray'},\n]\n\n# Reference: 12am is at y_12am, each hour = avg_spacing\n# time_from_midnight_minutes = (y - y_12am) / avg_spacing * 60\n\ndef y_to_time(y, y_12am, spacing):\n    minutes_from_midnight = (y - y_12am) / spacing * 60\n    # Round to nearest 15 min\n    minutes_rounded = round(minutes_from_midnight / 15) * 15\n    h = int(minutes_rounded // 60) % 24\n    m = int(minutes_rounded % 60)\n    suffix = 'am' if h < 12 else 'pm'\n    h12 = h if h <= 12 else h - 12\n    if h12 == 0: h12 = 12\n    return f\"{h12}:{m:02d}{suffix}\", minutes_rounded, minutes_from_midnight\n\nprint(\"\\n--- Appointment block times ---\")\nfor r in colored_rects:\n    start_str, start_min, start_exact = y_to_time(r['y0'], y_12am, avg_spacing)\n    end_str, end_min, end_exact = y_to_time(r['y1'], y_12am, avg_spacing)\n    print(f\"\\n{r['color']}:\")\n    print(f\"  y0={r['y0']:.2f} -> {start_str} (exact: {start_exact:.2f} min, rounded: {start_min})\")\n    print(f\"  y1={r['y1']:.2f} -> {end_str} (exact: {end_exact:.2f} min, rounded: {end_min})\")\n\nEOF\n","description":"Calculate appointment block times from PDF coordinates"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":3,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2144,"cache_read_input_tokens":8777,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":2144,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":1,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":"toolu_01XLNADKDfucubwmz4rcmErk","session_id":"e94da18f-8678-4b98-bb67-f176dc6b73cb","uuid":"83188e19-0a02-469f-811b-fd674d81f930"}
